name: Qodo
tagline: AI platform spanning IDE assistant, CLI, and Qodo Merge PR review with test generation; enterprise on-prem and air-gapped options.
license: Proprietary (the open-source PR-Agent is now community-owned and separate)
pricing: Pro Team $30/mo base (up to 30 users) + credit packs at $0.012/credit (~18 reviews per 2,500-credit pack, ~$1.50-1.70/review); credits expire monthly; Enterprise custom
selfHostedNote: Enterprise offers single-tenant SaaS, on-prem, and air-gapped deployment at custom pricing.
modelControl: Vendor-managed models on SaaS; self-hosted model options on Enterprise air-gapped deployments

01-multi-dimensional-context.note: Repo-aware RAG-based context; cross-repo and codebase-graph depth not documented.

02-rule-centric.note: Rules system with unlimited rules on the commercial platform; default-quiet posture not documented.

03-dual-workflow.note: One subscription spans IDE assistant (Gen), CLI, and Qodo Merge PR review.

04-business-logic.note: Ticket/requirements validation not documented in the sources we verified.

05-continuous-learning.note: No public documentation of learning from review history found in our sources.

06-sandbox-validation.note: Test generation is a core platform capability; sandbox validation of review findings not documented.

07-economic-transparency.note: No BYOK on standard plans (~140 credits/review at $0.012); self-hosted models on Enterprise air-gapped.

08-actionability.note: One-click fix depth for the commercial product not documented in our sources.
